I need to write a JavaScript function that computes a running total of an array of non-negative numbers, but caps the sum at a given positive value. Once the running total reaches the cap, all subsequent positions should remain at that cap.

I drafted a loop-based implementation that tracks a running total and a capped flag. I also considered a simpler version using `Math.min(total + num, cap)` to enforce the cap directly.

The `Math.min` approach is confirmed correct. Once the running total reaches the cap, adding any non-negative number keeps the sum at `cap`, so all subsequent positions remain capped.
